# SimDirs

> An independent directory of travel SIM and eSIM providers. Each listing records
> what a plan costs on the official page, how long a number stays alive, and where
> the traffic exits. English at https://simdirs.com/, Chinese at https://simdirs.com/zh/.

## Directory

- [All providers](https://simdirs.com/sims/): starting price, data, validity, hotspot support, network
- [Airalo](https://simdirs.com/sims/airalo/): 200+ destinations, from $4 for 1GB/3 days
- [Holafly](https://simdirs.com/sims/holafly/): unlimited data only, priced per day
- [Saily](https://simdirs.com/sims/saily/): per-GB pricing from the NordVPN team
- [CMLink UK](https://simdirs.com/sims/cmlink-uk/): UK number plus a mainland secondary number
- [giffgaff](https://simdirs.com/sims/giffgaff/): UK number that costs pennies a year to keep

## Guides and field notes

- [Free eSIM trials 2026](https://simdirs.com/news/free-esim-trials-2026/): every zero-cost offer we could verify, with the catches
- [eSIM exit IP guide](https://simdirs.com/news/esim-exit-ip-guide-2026/): why travel eSIMs exit through datacenter IPs, and how to check yours
- [UK SIM keep-alive rules](https://simdirs.com/news/uk-sim-keep-alive-guide-2026/): 12 UK providers compared on annual cost and failure modes
- [Verification numbers](https://simdirs.com/news/esim-verification-number-guide-2026/): picking a foreign number for SMS codes
- [CMLink vs CTExcel](https://simdirs.com/news/cmlink-vs-ctexcel-uk-comparison-2026/): two EE-based MVNOs, compared on keep-alive and China data
- [Japan eSIM guide 2026](https://simdirs.com/news/japan-esim-guide-2026/): networks and prices
- [How to choose a travel eSIM](https://simdirs.com/news/how-to-choose-travel-esim-2026/): by trip type
